correctness.rationale: The two exact coordinate eliminations reduce the reduced complete intersection to \(y^2+z^3\); in characteristic 3 its Jacobian scheme is \(y=0,\ z^3=0\). The remaining E1/E3 points are smooth. Transition \(z\prime=a^{-4}z\) is exact, proving the split \(\mathcal O(-4)\) truncated algebra with \(\mathcal O(-8)\) square. Euler characteristic gives \(12m-9\). The attached polynomial verifier independently rechecks polynomial identities, finite matrix ranks, and endpoint Jacobian ranks. Complete-integral and all-degree statements follow from the proof, not finite enumeration.

originality.rationale: Aprodu et al. Theorem 5.1 and §5.4 genuinely cover the broader characteristic-odd Gorenstein/normalization and hence the CI surface; those are not counted as new. Detailed inspected relevant sections do not give the global scheme-theoretic characteristic-3 Jacobian singular locus or its split conormal direction, degree, and genus. Kurmann and Chipalkatti treat characteristic-zero coincident-root schemes. Distinct mathematical-record near matches are not equivalent or stronger. Priority remains qualified against uninspected specialists. Park (2022) was also inspected in its original full text, including the characteristic hypotheses and central geometric-syzygy arguments, and no scheme-theoretic Jacobian calculation for the quartic was located.
residual_risks: An unlocated older or newer source may contain the same Jacobian scheme in an equivalent formalism; searches and inspected source sections do not prove historical uniqueness.
Other older specialist singular-scheme literature has not all been inspected; relevant primary tangential-syzygy papers were assessed on their material arguments, not merely titles.
The full graded homogeneous Jacobian coordinate-ring Hilbert function is not asserted; sheaf global sections need not equal graded components for small twists.

value.rationale: The canonical scheme-theoretic singular locus of a natural degree-six tangential surface has a wild-characteristic length-three structure, whereas a transverse cusp in characteristic zero has Jacobian length two. The precise \(\mathcal O(-4)\) gluing controls its global Hilbert polynomial \(12m-9\), degree 12, genus 10, and all sheaf-section counts. These invariants cannot be read off from the reduced quartic or inherited from the ambient complete-intersection syzygies and are motivated by positive-characteristic degenerations of classical tangential varieties.
